notes: Nothing is invented for a new account any more. With no bodyweight entered the app used to fall back to a hardcoded 80 kg AND PRINT IT, telling you your bodyweight was 80 kg and scoring your bench against it. Without a real weight Strength now says so and asks for one, exactly like the other attributes do when they have nothing to go on

A fresh install no longer seeds a workout into your log. It used to insert a real session on first run, so a new account charts, XP, badges, muscle bars and Discipline all counted training that never happened. Loading that session is still available on purpose in Profile
The year chart only plots months since your first logged session, instead of eleven empty months and a spike
